title: Dubbing: turn a clip into many languages

body.text: feature converts the speech in a clip into another language while keeping the original tone. Make Thai content into English (or vice versa) quickly — great for reaching audiences abroad. Check the translation and lip timing before publishing.

example: Upload a Thai product-review clip → make an English-voice version with Dubbing to post on an international channel

title: Export and use it
